name: School Haze in a Lusty Maze
source:
The planet of Ero-Earth, made by the goddess of love Eros, has recently been struck by an affliction that changed most of the men into women. In order for the population to survive the next generation will have to put in a lot of 'hard' work. 

Follow the adventures of Red, Yellow, Blue, and Green as they start learning of their new responsibilities and the full love of the goddess that created them.

[From [url=https://homestuck-is-dead.itch.io/school-haze-in-a-lusty-maze]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
由爱神厄洛斯（Eros）创造的爱神地球（Ero-Earth）最近遭受了一场苦难，导致大多数男性变成了女性。为了让人们生存下去，下一代必须付出大量的“艰苦”工作。

跟随红、黄、蓝、绿的冒险，他们开始了解自己的新责任以及创造他们的女神的全部爱。

[来自[url=https://homestuck-is-dead.itch.io/school-haze-in-a-lusty-maze]itch.io[/url]]
